events.title: Australian Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading significantly lower on Friday, extending the losses in the previous six sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,650 level, with weakness across most sectors led by gold miners and technology stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Water On Friday
events.description: The China stock market turned lower again on Thursday, one day after ending the four-day losing streak in which it had slumped almost 100 points or 2.7 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,580-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Friday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Take Further Damage On Friday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market turned lower again on Thursday, one day after ending the two-day losing streak in which it had tumbled almost 3,600 points or 8.6 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 38,430-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Friday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Hand Back Thursday's Gains
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Thursday ended the five-day losing streak in which it had tumbled more than 225 points or 4.5 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just beneath the 5,080-point plateau although it may head south again on Friday.

events.title: Japan Consumer Prices Jump 0.8% In October
events.description: Overall consumer prices in Japan spiked 0.8 percent on month in October, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications said on Friday.

events.title: Continue Consolidation Expected For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has tracked lower in three straight sessions, sinking more than 20 points or 1.3 percent along the way. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,565-point plateau and it may take further damage again on Friday.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked higher in consecutive trading days, climbing more than 580 points or 1 percent along the way. The Nikkei 225 now sits just beneath the 59,450-point plateau although it may spin its wheels on Friday.

events.title: KOSPI May Run Out Of Steam On Friday
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, rallying almost 170 points or 3.4 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,140-point plateau although investors may lock in gains on Friday.

events.title: Japan Inflation Data Due On Friday
events.description: Japan will on Friday release October figures for consumer prices, highlighting a modest day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ticks Higher As Fed Rate Hike Expectations Continue To Rise
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved up a little on Thursday as investors raised their bets on a rate hike by the U.S. Federal Reserve following the release of hawkish comments by several central bank officials in the last month's meeting. In addition, with fresh concerns over possible U.S. attacks on Iran, oil-linked inflationary pressure returned to markets.

events.title: South Korea Producer Prices Slip 0.1% In October
events.description: Producer prices in South Korea eased 0.1 percent on month in October, the Bank of Korea said in Friday's preliminary ready - following the 0.1 percent increase in September.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Lower Again
events.description: The Switzerland stock market ended notably lower on Thursday, in line with markets across Europe, as early buoyancy over Anthropic's record IPO offering subsided quickily and investors turned cautious due to escalating geopolitical tensions.

events.title: European Markets Retreat After Positive Start, End Notably Lower
events.description: European markets pared early gains and settle lower on Thursday as oil prices climbed higher amid escalating tensions between Iran and the U.S. The market opened on a positive note as concerns about Artificial Intelligence trade eased thanks to Anthropic's record IPO offering.
